steps.en: Officer opens a page to set e-adjournment rules
steps.id: Officer membuka halaman pengaturan aturan e-adjournment
steps.why_en: No e-adjournment screen or feature exists anywhere in the system.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar atau fitur e-adjournment di sistem.

steps.en: Officer allows or blocks e-adjournment per ID type
steps.id: Officer mengizinkan atau memblokir e-adjournment per jenis ID
steps.why_en: ID types are known, but no setting for e-adjournment exists.
steps.why_id: Jenis ID dikenal, tetapi tidak ada pengaturan e-adjournment.

steps.en: The setting is saved and used when court cases are handled
steps.id: Pengaturan disimpan dan dipakai saat kasus pengadilan diproses
steps.why_en: Nothing stores the setting and no court case handling reads it.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang menyimpan pengaturan dan tidak ada proses kasus pengadilan yang membacanya.
